summary: This directory defines the core abstractions, interfaces, and shared types for creating, configuring, and executing AI-integrated tools within the application, providing a standard contract for tool implementations and their lifecycle management.
responsibilities: Define standard interfaces for AI-integrated tools
Establish contracts for tool execution and configuration
Track active tool execution tasks and identifiers
Define policies for tool execution approval
relationships: The AiTool interface provides the structural requirements for defining tools that can be executed within the system.
AiToolExecutionContext aggregates the configuration, identity, and environmental data necessary for a tool to function.
Approval policies act as a gatekeeper to evaluate whether a tool execution instance can proceed.
designDecisions: Use of interfaces to enforce strict tool structure and metadata requirements
Separation of execution context from tool configuration
Strongly typed identifiers for tracking tool execution lifecycles
